fees.title: Fees
fees.intro: Clear rules for buyers and sellers. WineTreff does not charge buyers marketplace commissions, premiums, transaction fees, Buy Again fees, search fees, or basic AI fees.
fees.buyerTax: Applicable taxes, excise duties, and customs charges
fees.processingBody: Deducted from seller proceeds and disclosed separately from WineTreff commission. Planning estimate: 2.5% + €0.25 per payment. The ledger records the payment provider’s actual charge after settlement.

metadata.title: WineTreff — Fine bottles, fixed price
metadata.description: Marketplace for wines, spirits, rare bottles, and beverage collectibles. Buyers pay only the listed price, shipping, and applicable taxes.
